  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/z61y0s2xzngyxy8pndp9hqq23s7z1ywq-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/2.9.1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/z61y0s2xzngyxy8pndp9hqq23s7z1ywq-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.14.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
